description: Read the organization's general settings: document processing mode, matter-number pattern, padding, and whether titles show that number, practice jurisdictions, prompt caching, organization AI instructions, memory extraction, time policy, and the time zone whose calendar decides the organization's day. declaredFeatureIds identifies policies in force; capabilities contains caller decisions; deploymentFeatures supplies deployment availability. timeZoneSource says whether the zone was chosen or derived from the primary practice jurisdiction (Europe/Prague for CZ and SK, UTC otherwise). An organization that has never saved settings gets the defaults rather than an error.
